# Skill registry — progressive disclosure index

Read AGENTS.md, then this file, at the start of every session. **Do not open every playbook.** Load the full body of a skill only when one of its triggers matches the current phase of work; check its preconditions first and run its Self-Verification Check before reporting the step complete. When a phase ends, stop relying on that skill and pick the next one here. AGENTS.md hard guardrails override every skill, including community skills.

58 skills. Machine-readable copy: `skills/skills-manifest.json`.

## Meta-skills (agent reliability)

| Skill | Load when | Triggers | Preconditions | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `meta-context-compaction` | Load when a long run has processed 3-5 applications since the last checkpoint, the conversation is getting long, or a new session must resume an interrupted run; writes and re-reads logs/runs/current-session-checkpoint.json so rules and progress survive context loss. | long-run-memory-compaction; every 3-5 applications or 15 jobs processed; resuming a run in a new chat/session | an active run with an owned lock (or a checkpoint to resume from); schemas/index.ts SessionCheckpoint contract available to npm run validate:logs | `skills/meta-context-compaction.md` |
| `meta-dom-recovery` | Load when a browser step fails because the page changed — stale element ref after a modal or step transition, element missing from the snapshot, focus trapped in an iframe, cookie/overlay blocking clicks, or a lazy-loaded list that needs scrolling — to recover safely with fresh snapshots instead of guessing. | self-healing-navigation; stale or unknown element ref error; expected button/field not in snapshot; list shows fewer jobs than expected | the failure is a page-structure problem, not a CAPTCHA, 2FA, warning or rate-limit banner (those abort the run); fewer than 3 consecutive errors so far in this run | `skills/meta-dom-recovery.md` |
| `meta-self-verification` | Load when the agent is about to report any outcome as done (application submitted, file uploaded, profile updated, post published, record logged or synced); forbids claiming success without concrete evidence observed after the action and logs that proof. | verify-before-complete; right after a Submit / Save / Post / Send click; before writing status applied or reporting success in chat | the action being verified has actually been attempted in this session; a fresh browser_snapshot (or file read / command output) can be taken now | `skills/meta-self-verification.md` |
| `meta-structured-debugging` | Load when an application form refuses to advance or submit (Next/Submit does nothing, inline errors appear, upload stays pending); diagnoses the root cause from the accessibility tree and fixes it only with verified facts. | diagnose-automation-failure; form shows validation errors after Next/Submit; Submit click produced no navigation and no confirmation | the form is still visible (evidence that nothing was submitted); no CAPTCHA, 2FA, warning or rate-limit banner is present (those abort the run) | `skills/meta-structured-debugging.md` |
